preparation_scripts.initial_bundle:
import json,hashlib,shutil,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); b=root/'build/highlight-rounding';out=root/'build/highlight-rounding-cloud';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
remote=Path('/home/mgsloan/highlight-rounding-20260914')
for sub in ['binaries','queries']:shutil.copytree(b/sub,out/sub)
shutil.copy2(b/'build-manifest.json',out/'build-manifest.json')
(out/'jobs').mkdir();(out/'inputs').mkdir();(out/'grammars').mkdir()
jobs=json.loads((b/'jobs.json').read_text())
for job in jobs:
 grammar=job['grammar'];old=Path(grammar['library']);shutil.copy2(old,out/'grammars'/old.name);grammar['library']=str(remote/'grammars'/old.name)
 q=job['query'];q['path']=str(remote/'queries'/Path(q['path']).name)
 for source in job['sources']:
  old=Path(source['path']);name=source['sha256']+old.suffix;shutil.copy2(old,out/'inputs'/name);source['path']=str(remote/'inputs'/name)
 (out/'jobs'/(job['name']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(job,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'jobs.json').write_text(json.dumps(jobs,indent=2)+'\n')
shutil.copy2(root/'tools/squatter/benchmark-query-workloads.py',out/'benchmark-query-workloads.py')
shutil.copy2(root/'crates/squatter-bench/src/bin/query-workload.rs',out/'query-workload.rs')
shutil.copy2(root/'build/byte-rounding/manifest.json',out/'layout-build-manifest.json')
for job in jobs:
 for p in job['query']['parts']:
  data=(root/'build/squat-corpus-10k/queries'/Path(p['path']).name).read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==p['sha256']
with tarfile.open(root/'build/highlight-rounding-cloud.tar.gz','w:gz') as t:t.add(out,arcname=remote.name)
print(len(jobs),'jobs packaged')
preparation_scripts.full_tags_bundle:
from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,tarfile
b=Path('build/highlight-rounding');out=Path('build/highlight-full-tags');out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);(out/'jobs').mkdir();(out/'queries').mkdir()
remote=Path('/home/mgsloan/highlight-rounding-20260914')
for p in ['binaries','build-manifest.json']:(out/p).symlink_to('../'+p)
jobs=json.loads((b/'full-tags-jobs.json').read_text())
for j in jobs:
 g=j['grammar'];g['library']=str(remote/'grammars'/Path(g['library']).name)
 q=j['query'];old=Path(q['path']);shutil.copy2(old,out/'queries'/old.name);q['path']=str(remote/'full-tags/queries'/old.name)
 for s in j['sources']:s['path']=str(remote/'inputs'/(s['sha256']+Path(s['path']).suffix))
 (out/'jobs'/(j['name']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(j,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'jobs.json').write_text(json.dumps(jobs,indent=2)+'\n')
with tarfile.open('build/highlight-full-tags.tar.gz','w:gz') as t:t.add(out,arcname='highlight-rounding-20260914/full-tags')
